QuestInfo.name: [Geardock] On Whose Authority?
QuestInfo.1:
Travel to #m410013700#.
It can be found through the portal on the left side of #m410013709#.
QuestInfo.2:
You rescued Gob from Jupiter. However, his former apprentice, Melian, was sacrificed to the very forge she'd obsessed over.
In the end, Jupiter was consumed by the transmuted entity, leaving behind his mechanical arm and unrealized dreams of a new era of gods.
